description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class PurgeEmployeeDaoTest for testing the PurgeDao class within the OrangeHRM Maintenance plugin, specifically testing employee data purge functionalities.

classes.name: PurgeEmployeeDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the PurgeDao related to employee data within the OrangeHRM maintenance plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates a PurgeDao instance, sets fixture path, and populates test data.

methods.name: testIsEmployeePurgeable
methods.description: Tests whether certain employee IDs are correctly identified as purgeable or not.

methods.name: testExtractDataFromEmpNumber
methods.description: Verifies extraction of employee data and related comments based on employee number and table data.
